purpose: Fix round 18 (Sol max gate r2 finding 1): for every Storage-classified node of Plans/event_datetime_inventory.json, one valid committed object reaching that node. The per-node self-checks (datetime_node_*) validate it through a neutral reference with the node's complete committed resource preloaded, then set each classified timestamp field to an invalid string and require refusal at that field. Each object is copied from the committed Plans object named by its source, where it was found valid at the node; objects are keyed by their checker-only digest.
